description: Check the status of an Oathe Scan audit submitted via submit_audit. Wait 90 seconds after submission before first poll, then poll every 10 seconds until status is "complete" or "failed". Statuses: queued, scanning, analyzing, summarizing, finalizing, complete, failed. Terminal statuses: complete, failed. When complete, the response includes the full audit report with trust score, verdict, and findings.
name: check_audit_status
